name: ENF Novels: Cold Night
source:
Pamela is a girl like many others. One day she decides to take a walk in the park with her friends. They thus lie down under a tree and fall asleep. When she wakes up, however, she is alone, not only that, it is late at night and her clothes have disappeared. Pamela must get out of the park unharmed, will she succeed?​

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052460/ENF_Novels_Cold_Night/]Steam[/url]]
